input.text: (LinkedIn message) Hi, I'm Auberon Kestell, a recruiter working on Ramp's security hiring. We have a Security Engineer, Cloud opening that is fully remote from anywhere in the US, with a salary range of $95K-$115K. Would you like to set up a call this week?

notes: The official posting is New York (HQ), hybrid, $211.4K-$290.6K. The message claims fully remote at $95K-$115K, so workplace and compensation band (more than 20% apart) are material diffs. The Safe Route is careers_page_only because vacancy is not officially_confirmed.
